items.title: Reducedness ascends along weakly etale morphisms

items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y weakly etale with Y reduced, the lemma concludes X is reduced — the reduced-mirror of the normality going-up law (card L16162, collected last wave) in the weakly etale toolkit. The retained proof is written: the chapter's affine dictionary for weakly etale morphisms (lemma weakly-etale-characterize, card L16119) reduces the claim to rings; the ring theorem is More on Algebra, lemma absolutely-flat-over-absolutely-flat — weakly etale ring maps are precisely the absolutely flat (von Neumann regular) presentations in the relevant sense, and absolute flatness of A over a reduced base reflects reducedness up along the map — imported verbatim from the algebra chapter. Retained author proof at lines 19086-19091.
